# hg observability

**What this page tells you:** every `hg observability` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The observability overlay: inventory and proof.

## Synopsis

```text
hg observability inspect [flags]
hg observability prove [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## `hg observability inspect`

```text
hg observability inspect [flags]
```

The canonical workload inventory joined with live source levels.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--control-plane` | `<url>` | — | Base URL of the control plane (the exposed Nexus). |

## `hg observability prove`

```text
hg observability prove [flags]
```

Obs001..obs010: schema, all 7 sources, never-green, links, secret scan, promised dashboard uids.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--control-plane` | `<url>` | — | Base URL of the control plane (the exposed Nexus). |
